comment: Halligan is a fork of ax-llm/ax and publishes its own packages, never upstream's. Source metadata in this repository deliberately keeps upstream's names (@ax-llm/ax, axllm, dev.axllm:ax) so upstream syncs stay cheap textual merges. Published identity is applied at publish time, in the CI checkout only, by scripts/apply-halligan-identity.mjs reading this file. Never commit the applied (rewritten) state. Import-level identity never changes: the Python import package stays axllm, the Rust library target stays axllm, the Java package stays dev.axllm.ax, so `import axllm`, `use axllm::...` and `dev.axllm.ax.*` keep working for consumers of the fork. npm intra-workspace dependencies are rewritten from the same npm.workspaces map: any dependencies or peerDependencies key that is itself a mapped workspace name is renamed to its published name, with the version range left untouched. Publish-time identity is not only names: the metadata section below carries the fork's repository, homepage, issues, author and description prefix, which the same script writes into every published manifest so the registry pages point at 24601/halligan rather than upstream.

metadata.author: Basit Mustafa
metadata.note: Committed source keeps upstream's ax-llm/ax and axllm.dev values. These are applied only in the publish checkout. The description prefix is idempotent: a description that already starts with the prefix is left alone.

npm.publish_from: each workspace's dist/ directory, written by scripts/postbuild.js from the rewritten workspace package.json
npm.ordering_note: Run npm ci BEFORE applying identity. The rewrite intentionally does not touch package-lock.json, so a later npm ci would fail on the name mismatch. Nothing after the rewrite installs.

pypi.note: Only the [project] name changes. [tool.setuptools.packages.find] include and [tool.setuptools.package-data] must keep naming the axllm import package.

crates.note: [package] name becomes the published crate name; an explicit [lib] name = "axllm" keeps `use axllm::...` working.

maven.note: GitHub Packages needs only GITHUB_TOKEN and packages: write. It needs no GPG key and no Sonatype Portal account, so the fork does not use upstream's Maven Central release profile.

go.note: Go has no registry upload and no publish job in this repository; consumers resolve a module from a git tag. The checked-in module path is still upstream's github.com/ax-llm/ax/packages/go, so `go get github.com/24601/halligan/packages/go` does not resolve today. Fixing that means changing the AxIR Go emitter, not a publish-time rewrite, and is tracked as separate work.
